args.query: SELECT participant_id, cohort, contact_notes FROM participants;

INSERT INTO cohort_summary (cohort, size, example_comment) SELECT cohort, COUNT(*), (SELECT p2.contact_notes FROM participants p2 WHERE p2.cohort = p.cohort AND p2.contact_notes IS NOT NULL AND p2.contact_notes NOT LIKE '%@%' AND p2.contact_notes NOT LIKE '%DO NOT SHARE%' LIMIT 1) FROM participants p GROUP BY cohort;
